# jlang

> The J programming language, with J sessions, IPython magics and a Jupyter kernel for Python.

## Modules

- [jlang.core](https://answerdotai.github.io/jlanguage/core.html.md): Run the J language from Python and Jupyter through libj: sessions, magics and a Jupyter kernel.
